release_notes: Build 105 makes every SEO warning explain exactly why the quiz was flagged and what change is recommended.
The SEO audit grid now has separate Why flagged and Recommended fix columns instead of relying on one clipped audit-result cell.
Selecting a quiz shows the full finding and full recommendation in a dedicated detail panel below the grid.
After each audit, the first warning or needs-attention quiz is selected automatically so its explanation is visible immediately.
Duplicate SEO titles, duplicate visible titles, slug problems, missing metadata and search/social length warnings now each provide targeted repair guidance.
Ready quizzes explicitly state that no change is recommended.
Regression tests require every non-ready audit row to contain both a reason and a recommendation.
Build 104 dedicated SEO administration and Build 103 archive fixes remain included unchanged.
No quiz scoring, publishing schedule, visibility, account or analytics behavior is changed.
